verdict.rationale: GitCafe rulesets protect matching branches or tags and can require pull requests, reviews, passing checks and code-owner approval, or block deletion and force pushes. An Evaluate mode lets teams trial rules as warnings before enforcing them, and Buildkite builds show up as PR checks, so merge gating is configurable. Missing for 10: evidence of organization-wide rulesets for standardizing checks across many repos, and independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works.
